basics.name: Yash Jayswal
basics.label: ML/AI Speech Engineer
basics.summary: ML/AI Speech Engineer at Samsung HQ, Suwon, South Korea. IIT Delhi graduate (B.Tech Electrical Engineering). Experienced in ASR/LLM inference optimization, C++ cloud infrastructure, and ML systems research.

work.name: CodeMiner (Open Source)
work.summary: Contributing to an open-source code retrieval system for AI coding agents, targeting VLDB.
highlights: Built C++ indexing backend and inference optimizations for embedding and reranker serving.
Improved token efficiency and reduced end-to-end retrieval latency for AI coding agents.

work.name: Samsung HQ
work.summary: Working on multilingual, low-latency ASR models and scalable C++ cloud infrastructure for Bixby.
highlights: Fine-tuned a Qwen MoE streaming ASR model using LoRA adapters, investigating WER-latency tradeoffs under streaming constraints, achieving 8% WER on multilingual transcription.

Developed a multilingual ASR model (31 languages) optimized for real-time streaming using quantization, chunking, K-V caching, VAD, and align-attention, achieving ≈ 45% latency reduction from baseline.
Optimized ASR reliability under high-load conditions via advanced GPU synchronization techniques, achieving high hardware utilization and a 2% improvement in recognition accuracy during peak traffic.
Implemented scalable C++ model handling modules within a multi-user Bixby Cloud environment for inference-optimized Fast Conformer-based ASR models (encoder-decoder and LSTM architectures).
Designed an end-to-end robust data collection pipeline for low-latency ASR model training.

work.name: Samsung HQ
work.summary: Developed phonetic similarity metrics and database modules for speech recognition.
highlights: Developed Name Entity Replacer for Personal Database module with tolerance toward mispronounced names.
Proposed novel phoneme similarity metric based on manner of articulation paired with Metaphone and Soundex algorithm.
Achieved 96.3% and 98.3% accuracy for spoken name matching, reducing recognition errors by ≈ 55%.

publications.name: A Simple Model for Panic Driven Motion in a Refugee Camp
publications.publisher: Journal of Human Behavior in the Social Environment (JHBSE)
publications.summary: Simulated crowd dynamics via numerical mollification and RK4; optimized obstacle configurations reducing fatalities by 70%.

projects.name: LLM Scaling & Systems Optimization (JAX/TPU)
projects.summary: Engineered distributed Transformer components in JAX with TP, PP, and FSDP to overcome auto-compiler scaling bottlenecks.
highlights: Hand-coded a Mixture of Experts (MoE) layer via jax.shard_map with explicit All-to-All token routing, completely eliminating native AllGather memory explosions.
Leveraged XLA trace profiling to hide interconnect latency behind compute, achieving a 43x MoE speedup (73ms to 1.7ms) on TPU v5e-8.

projects.name: Vision Semantic Communication
projects.summary: Developed a generative AI-based semantic communication pipeline for image communication targeting 6G, guided by Prof. Brejesh Lall, IIT Delhi.
highlights: Proposed a guided Stable Diffusion + ControlNet approach using image captions, edge maps, and scaled-down latent representations.
Achieved a 0.31 LPIPS score on VGG net in a noisy communication channel, a 40% improvement over the previous best.

projects.name: Panic-Driven Crowd Dynamics

highlights: Applied numerical mollification and optimized obstacle shapes
